title: Adagrose Ltd is renamed McCartney Productions Ltd | 1969
content:
Paul McCartney had acquired Adagrose Ltd on 12 February 1969. On 21 August it was renamed McCartney Productions Ltd.

The company was for McCartney to manage his own business interests, and marked the beginnings of a formal break with The Beatles, who had recently been appointed the group’s business manager. McCartney had become increasingly interested in acquiring music publishing rights, and wished to control his own interests without the other Beatles.

The first project undertaken by the company was the acquisition of the film rights to Rupert the Bear in April 1970.

Up until [1973], my relationship with music publishers had been somewhat troubled thanks to things like losing control of Northern Songs, our publishing company for The Beatles, at the end of the 1960s through to the court case still happening when this song was written, where I’d had to sue my best friends from childhood to ensure we would keep control of our songs, rather than ‘other parties’ controlling them. All of that played a big part in setting up MPL, my own publishing company.
Paul McCartney
The Lyrics: 1956 To The Present

McCartney Productions Ltd eventually evolved into MPL Communications.
